nodes.label: Never Trust Browser-Sent Discord/Steam/Player IDs
nodes.rationale: Server reads the Discord ID only from the token user's verified discord identity and resolves exactly one identities_player row.

nodes.label: Do-Not-Change Scope (backend, HomePage, migrations)
nodes.rationale: Server-side resolution already uses only the verified Discord ID from the token; no backend change needed.

nodes.label: Identity and Credential Decisions
nodes.rationale: Reuse the shared Supabase Auth; no second password store; keep identities_player and economy data unchanged via read-only lookup.

nodes.label: Account Archiving (archived_at)
nodes.rationale: Archived accounts are hidden and blocked from new transfers but rows and ledger history are preserved; Main cannot be archived and archiving requires zero balance and another active account.

nodes.label: Fictional Role-play Acknowledgement
nodes.rationale: Required on first visit so users know balances and transactions are fictional; remembered in the browser.

nodes.label: Supabase Manual Identity Linking
nodes.rationale: Required because signup creates the email/password user first, then links the verified Discord identity to the same Auth user.

nodes.label: Server-only Service-role Key
nodes.rationale: Used only by PHP for identity lookups and fab_* RPCs; never sent to the frontend or committed.

nodes.label: Supabase as Source of Truth
nodes.rationale: Supabase stores auth, username directory, player identities, accounts, balances and history; no local database runs.
